channel.title: Redwood City Dispatch
channel.description: Redwood City, San Carlos and Belmont news, once a week, from the Redwood City Dispatch.

item.title: San Carlos is weighing a ban on gas-powered leaf blowers
item.description: The council held a study session on November 9.

item.title: Redwood City named Sarah La Torra its library director on November 10
item.description: She has led the Redwood City Public Library as interim director since 2024 and first joined in 2007 as a teen services librarian; she helped build the library's Makerspace.

item.title: Redwood City's three self-service sandbag stations are open around the clock
item.description: They are at the Public Works Services Yard on Broadway, at the end of Radio Road near the dog park, and in the Fair Oaks Community Center parking lot; the limit is 24 bags per resident.

item.title: adopt the drain on your corner
item.description: Leaves on a storm drain grate are how a rainy night becomes a flooded intersection.
